item.title: First thoughts after watching Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 Episode 8
item.description:
This note includes a spoiler.

I watched Jobless Reincarnation season 3 episode 8 twice.

Alright. Finally the story started changing a little. It's a little interesting that demons aren't allowed in the flying fortress because Perugius doesn't like them. Because of that, Roxy wasn't allowed in. I guess she headed back by road on her own afterward because nobody was with her, and she knew it could take days. The reason why Rudy took time to be teleported was... Man God? Or the capacity of the magic? The teleport magic's animation reminded me of the background when Rudy met Man God.

Rudy also avoided answering, when he and Sylphie were asked, whether he knew Man God or not. She answered she didn't know, and I wondered whether she had just lied. Obviously, he lied because he had been attacked by Orsted the last time he answered that he knew. And they didn't have a way to recognize it. But I guess she didn't have such an experience, so she answered honestly. And in that case, why were they detected? Because of their magic capacity? Or magic without an incantation was detected, and they thought that was the handiwork of Man God, though Rudy figured it out by himself and taught her? Or, Rudy was actually created by Man God?

Anyhow, the flying fortress was a huge castle with nature inside it, and then they entered the throne room and met Perugius. He was intimidating, and many people were nervous, but Nanahoshi was calm and didn't hesitate to push back at him. Perugius was definitely a good guy. He also reacted to a couple of things: one was the fully autonomous doll, and the other was Rudy and Sylphie. I didn't know the intent behind naming their son if they had one, but did he have some intentions to bring Rudy and Sylphie onto his side? But why only a son? Zanoba's fully autonomous doll was rare even for him, so probably that fortress wasn't really industrialized. He also didn't know about the displacement incident. He thought it wasn't by humans, but was it really? I thought someone like Man God did it.

Also, we finally got to know why Elinalise got her curse. She was found in a labyrinth without her memory and emotions, and got emotions afterward, but never got her memories back. Even though she was married, her husband was killed and she needed to deal with her curse. And she needed to leave the elf village that had taken her in, because of her curse. Rudy empathized with her even though she hid her past, and this reminded me what a good character Rudy was. Rudy's past life was not going well.

Anyhow, then they talked about taking a lecture on teleport magic from Nanahoshi's master. And at lunch, they ate food similar to Japanese food. Because Nanahoshi really wanted to go back to her world, she shed tears while eating it, and I empathized with her. Then Cliff and Zanoba found a path to the underground, and some murals. But what were they? The Armored Dragon King immediately came and kicked them out. Did they mean something? He didn't say so, but were they murals from Laplace's time or something?

Also, Rudy was advised not to use his magic in the fortress. But Sylphie, who uses the same kind of magic as him, used hers when Nanahoshi came to their room because she was coughing a lot. Sylphie felt a little weird when she used her magic and tried to use more. But then Nanahoshi threw up blood. I didn't know it was because of her magic, or it was because of Nanahoshi's health, but probably the former. That place wasn't a good place to use magic for Sylphie or Rudy.

So, in the next episode, something will start happening. I want to see what's going to happen. They'll probably save Nanahoshi and come down from the flying fortress.

Scores

  • Episode: 8/10
  • Rudeus: 7/10
    • He was calm down from a few facts, he looked worried when he met Perugius, so I felt his sense of anxiety which is usual for normal people.
  • Sylphie: 8/10
    • She didn't want Rudy to be too close to Nanahoshi and she was jealous. It was cute.
  • Nanahoshi: 8/10
    • She might be the anime character who most wants to go back to her own world. I liked this.
    • She also pushed back at Perugius, so that was good.
  • Perugius: 5/10
    • He seems like a nice person, but he's still a king, or a god.
  • Elinalise: 7/10
    • Finally, we've seen why she got a curse
  • Zanoba: 6/10
    • I liked his attitude and how frankly he talked with Perugius.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 Episode 7
item.description:
This note includes a spoiler.

I watched Jobless Reincarnation season 3 episode 7 twice.

This episode was the one about the natural progression of academy life, which was graduation. The main focus of the graduation was Linia and Pursena. In order to decide who would lead their tribes, they fought. Rudy was just excited and enjoyed watching the fight, though he didn't expect them to go their separate ways afterward. The fight took a long time, but the animation wasn't good. They mostly animated only a few specific characters, or shot the fight from a long distance. Maybe the production saved effort in this episode because it wasn't an important fight. Anyhow, they were worried about going their separate ways, but it seemed like they met immediately after they departed the city, so they were still really like glue.

Another important part was Nanahoshi's experiment. Rudy kept helping her and this time, he felt the summoning magic was similar to the mass teleportation in the past. The animation effects were at first really similar to that, but then they changed, and what it summoned turned out to be a big watermelon. Nanahoshi also got sick often. Does this indicate something about the future, like she was going to disappear because she was summoned from another world and didn't fit into that world? Or was this just showing the details of this world?

For some reason they celebrated shortly after, and at the celebration, Roxy got drunk and sat on Rudy's lap. She was so cute. Norn also wanted to join the student council and she asked Rudy if it was okay for her to join. At first, I wondered why she asked, but then I realized she thought he would worry about her not doing well in her writing and sword training. Anyhow, Sylphie helped her and told him that Norn had already been helping the student council. So he made a sensible decision and allowed her to do it.

Then, right at the end, Nanahoshi told Rudy that her master might know how to cure his mother. I didn't see this coming, so that was Rudy's next move, but it was actually a pretty natural thing for him to do. Then she told him who her master was: one of the three heroes who defeated Laplace. How could she know that kind of person? Well, we'll probably find that out shortly. So, on to the next episode, which will probably start a new arc.

Scores

  • Episode: 7/10
    • This was all preparation for the upcoming arc.
  • Rudeus: 7/10
  • Roxy: 9/10
    • So adorable to sit on Rudy's lap while she was plastered
  • Sylphie: 8/10
  • Nanahoshi: 8/10
    • She got sick and showed her fragility.
  • Linia: 5/10
  • Pursena: 5/10
  • Norn: 7/10
    • She started doing a few things well, so we knew she was putting in the effort. We're like her parents, watching her grow.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 Episode 6
item.description:
This note includes a spoiler.

I watched Jobless Reincarnation season 3 episode 6 twice.

This episode was mostly between Rudy and Sara. Sara, and how he parted ways with her, was one issue Rudy hadn't solved until this episode. So the main focus in this episode was to solve it, and it started with Sylphie's kid and Rudy. Honestly, I didn't recognize Suzanne at first, but once I did, it made sense that she had quit being an adventurer and gotten married. And she even got a job as a nanny at Rudy's house. Then, obviously, Rudy met Sara on the next job, but he avoided her, or ran away from her. I was a little pissed off. Why would he do that? But then he talked with her about the past and what happened, and showed how mature he had become. In terms of Sara, she felt a little sad after talking to Rudy, and I thought she had regrets. She might have, but after talking to Rudy she understood why it couldn't have worked, and she moved on. And then she and Rudy really became good friends. I liked her.

Other than that, Roxy was so welcomed by the party and so respected. I felt it was off that Rudy didn't do much during the fight and just stayed still, but I guess he let his guard down because Roxy was there.

Princess Ariel was a little involved and did one thing for Rudy, and more for Sylphie. That one thing was how considerate she was. Sylphie was like a worrier, and she accepted too much. Or at least when I heard what she said, she sounded more like Rudy's mom than his wife.

From Eris's point of view, I didn't expect Nina to be able to use the Blade of Light. But somehow, because of desire or resolve, Eris's Blade of Light was superior to Nina's. Eris took a hit, but she was able to strike Nina's opening and blew her all the way into a wall. Eris showed that she was putting her energy into her wooden sword, but at the same time, she was smiling softly by thinking about Rudy, and that was quite a good attitude. It obviously showed how she had leeway while Nina rushed a little and lost.

Because Princess Ariel was a little involved, I felt like a new story would start. But I don't know. Maybe... a war will come?

Scores

  • Episode: 7/10
  • Rudeus: 7/10
    • I already forgot why he still had the hots for Eris
  • Roxy: 8/10
    • She was our goddess.
  • Sylphie: 6/10
    • Her dedication to Rudy was... too convenient for the story.
  • Eris: 7/10
    • As always, she is stubborn. But she only cared about a few things.
  • Nina: 6/10
    • Sounded like she had high hopes of reaching a higher position like the Sword King.
  • Sara: 8/10

item.title: First thoughts after watching Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 Episode 5
item.description:
This note includes a spoiler.

I watched Jobless Reincarnation season 3 episode 5 twice. 8/10. It seemed like this episode was meant to wrap up what happened after Rudeus came back to his mansion from the labyrinth.

Elinalise settled down with Cliff, instead of staying an adventurer. Cliff is a member of the Milis Church, but I don't think she is. I forgot about it, but she has a curse. How can she deal with it?

Also, the episode explained that there was no wedding of Rudeus and Roxy because the Migurd don't have that custom. So, this was the first episode that Roxy dressed up in something special at the wedding of Cliff and Elinalise, and it was so cute. She looked like a very cute kid.

Then what Rudy didn't do was throw Norn and Aisha their birthday celebrations. And he had a good memory and remembered the promise he had made with Paul about throwing a big party. And now he was responsible as the head of the Greyrats, so he planned and prepared it. When he was fishing with Norn, Aisha, and Roxy, he couldn't catch any fish, just a boot, so he cast a spell to catch fish. Even Roxy was a little disgusted with him. So, he had grown up a lot as the head of the Greyrats, but he still showed his childish side.

Roxy, on the other hand, still had a couple of challenges. Well, she was more like an introvert. Norn had a problem with her being Rudy's second wife, so Roxy wanted to get along with her, and fishing was her chance. I think she liked helping others, so it worked well and she taught Norn a few techniques. Also, she couldn't buy a hat when she found a good one. It was because the hat was too expensive. And Rudy and Sylphie bought and gave it to her as a wedding gift. That conversation between Sylphie and Roxy was, well, the polygamy point of view, so it was still kinda off to a monogamous person. But Sylphie really loved Rudy, and she was thankful to Roxy too. Roxy may still have felt awkward around her as the second wife, so I guess that was another thing she solved in the scene. Roxy's animation when she got the new hat from Sylphie was very detailed and well framed, so some of the animators must have liked this scene.

Zenith's behavior also improved a little, and she patted Norn's head and held Lilia's hand. Though, I don't know whether she'll ever fully recover, or when. Was her condition caused by magic, or by some other power? No idea how she'll turn out later.

I don't know what'll happen in the next episode. Apparently, Sara will show up again, so Rudy will probably get a job, maybe taking one from a guild. More than that, no idea. And I also have no idea when Rudy'll meet Eris next.
